mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.views, a.word_count, a.reading_time, a.is_top, a.publish_time, a.create_time FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.views DESC, a.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(views), 0) FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT id, views FROM blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED'
